Figure 2: Overview of the proposed QuReC framework. The upper part presents the overall encoder-decoder architecture, in which a Query Reconstruction and Response Calibration Block (QRCB) is inserted into each of the three decoder stages. The lower part illustrates the structure of a QRCB, which consists of a Degradation-Guided Query Reconstruction Module (DQRM) and a Local-Global Response Calibration Module (LGRCM).
